correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the four-qubit Pauli inversion identity P12+P13+P14=1+(A1+tau)/2>=1 with tau the nonnegative squared spin-flip overlap. The 4x4 Gram formula 256 P=64+2 sum_{r<s}|sum_{c=0}^3 i^(f_rc-f_sc)|² and equal parity of each integer real/imag part imply purities in multiples 1/64; at least one is >=ceil(64/3)/64=11/32. The displayed 16-digit phase witness has three exact numerator-88 purities and vanishing four one-qubit coherences. A unique subtraction of the five coefficients of affine phase gauge fixes f at 0,1,2,4,8, leaving exactly 4^11=4,194,304 classes. Independently compiled and executed a separately coded full C++ enumeration over all 4^11 canonical classes using exact integer Gram overlaps (not the stored checker); it found minimum 88/256, exactly 96 minimizers all with (88,88,88), and among all 2048 real-sign classes minimum 96/256 with 272 minimizers. Separately generated the complete transformed canonical orbit of an optimizer (24 permutations ×16 bit flips ×2 conjugations), yielding exactly 96 distinct classes. The 16 local-Z labels form an orthonormal Walsh basis for any flat vector. This is truly exhaustive for a finite search space, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: PASS: Equal-magnitude four-qubit fiducials with quarter-root diagonal phases form a natural finite preparation alphabet. The exact worst balanced-cut purity optimum quantifies the gap to unrestricted entanglement, and the complete optimizer census plus single orbit provides a usable classification for choosing entangled measurement fiducials. Real-only phase control strictly worsens the optimum. The orthonormal Z-basis consequence is known and is not the asserted new value.

final_claim: For all f:{0,1}^4->Z4, the minimum maximum of the three balanced bipartition reduced purities of the flat phase state 1/4 sum_x i^f(x)|x> is exactly 11/32. Exactly 96 equivalence classes modulo global and local affine quarter phases attain it, all in one bit-flip/permutation/conjugation orbit and with maximally mixed single qubits. Restricting to real ±1 phases raises optimum to 3/8. Every flat optimum gives a 16-state orthonormal local-Z-encoded basis.
limitations: Four qubits and all functions to Z4 only; not arbitrary complex phases or nonflat amplitudes.
96 classes modulo affine diagonal quarter-phases, and a single orbit under the explicitly stated finite symmetries, not full local-unitary equivalence.
No entanglement advantage claimed for noisy circuits, higher qubits or gate depth.
